comment: config(0, 0, 0, 0): no parameters, inputs, outputs or lights, so there is nothing to tag and no props. The language pill and the two font-size buttons are TransparentWidgets with their own onButton handlers rather than ParamWidgets (src/Manual.cpp:420-470), so they have no census position and cannot be reached by a help click; they are covered by a Note instead. Hovering is resolved from APP->event->hoveredWidget and matched against the plugin's own help table by control name (src/Manual.cpp:566-620). The panel prints only the module name and the three buttons.
